FEAT-5-S159.title: Allowlist Configuration and Tool Registry Contract
FEAT-5-S159.description: Define and implement a centralized allowlist configuration that maps tool names to their corresponding Pydantic schemas and handler functions, ensuring a strict contract for all permitted tools.

FEAT-5-S160.title: Unknown Tool Rejection and Error Handling
FEAT-5-S160.description: Implement explicit rejection logic for non-allowlisted tools, including structured error responses, safe fallback messaging, and prevention of execution for any tool not defined in the allowlist.

FEAT-5-S161.title: Tool Execution Audit Logging
FEAT-5-S161.description: Integrate debug logging to capture tool routing decisions, validation outcomes, execution timing, and error states for each tool invocation to support observability and QA traceability.

FEAT-5-S162.title: Conversation Context Injection into Tool Calls
FEAT-5-S162.description: Ensure the tool router correctly injects relevant chat history and context into tool execution inputs where required, maintaining consistency with the agent loop and improving downstream service accuracy.
